name: Yaourt phô mai
summary: A cold yogurt cup named beside Da Lat bánh căn and the morning xíu mại bowls.
origin: Visit Lâm Đồng bánh căn listings name yaourt phô mai. The food-tour note prices a yaourt beside bánh mì xíu mại.
howToEat: Eat it cold, next to a hot bowl or after the cakes. The listings do not print a recipe.
where: Bánh căn doors that print it: Cây Bơ at 56 Tăng Bạt Hổ, Lệ at 27/44 Yersin, and the door at 7 Tăng Bạt Hổ, which says bánh flan phô mai and sữa. The food-tour note ties yaourt to the xíu mại counters at 26 Hoàng Diệu and 26 Phạm Nhật Duật.
priceBand: The food-tour note prints 5,000 VND for yaourt and does not say phô mai. The bánh căn listings name yaourt phô mai and do not print that 5,000 VND figure. A single price is Check on arrival.
